title: Tacos al pastor
subtitle: Ordering at a taco stand
scene: A busy taco stand at night. The taquero slices pork off the spit.

lines.en: Good evening, young man! What can I get you?
lines.note: Joven is how people address a young man they don’t know. Polite and friendly.

lines.es: Buenas noches. Me da tres tacos al pastor, por favor.
lines.en: Good evening. Three tacos al pastor, please.

culture.title: Tacos al pastor
culture.text: Pork marinated in chiles and cooked on a vertical spit, with a slice of pineapple on top. Order at the stand, eat standing up, and pay at the end.

lines.note: Con todo = with onion and cilantro.

lines.es: Sí, con todo. ¿Tiene agua de horchata?
lines.en: Yes, with everything. Do you have horchata?
lines.note: Horchata is a sweet rice drink. Aguas frescas are fruit or rice drinks.

lines.en: So tasty! How much is it?

culture.title: Paying at a stand
culture.text: Pay after you eat. Tell the taquero what you had, and keep small bills and coins handy: stands are cash only.

lines.es: ¡A usted, joven! Que le vaya bien.
lines.en: Thank you, young man! Take care.
